“Out of the hundred who enter each year, only three leave at the end of their ten-year term. The rest remain under the Academy's charge as is recorded.”
The Contract's clause was quiet in the packet but not shy: ten years.
When she set the pen to the Contract she wrote 'sold' in the space the Folio called Provenance.
She signed her name with a hand that would make do.

The Binding Seal waited on the table, a mound of beeswax and a small iron signet beside a bottle that smelled of tincture. Even in the dry light she could tell it smelled of beeswax and a bitter iron tang.
claims.value: wax, iron, tincture; smell of beeswax and bitter iron tang
